annotations.title: Check a Reddit catalog feed import

description: See how Reddit’s fetches of a catalog’s product feed went. Without importId: the catalog’s recent imports with their status (PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED, SKIPPED) and added / modified / deleted / invalid counts. With importId: that import’s issue rows (which products failed and why) plus a time-limited link to Reddit’s full import report. An import whose file did not change is SKIPPED and has no report. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

catalogId.description: catalog whose feed imports to read

importId.description: one import's id, for its issue rows and report link; omit for recent imports

name: get_reddit_ads_catalog_import
